_comment: Single source of truth for the model instruction content store. Renders to each model's _COPILOT_INSTRUCTIONS table + always-on router via emit_model.py. Shared blocks live under blocks/; per-model blocks under models/<slug>/. Cross-references use {{ref:anchor}} (rendered to the row's backtick'd key); model artifact ids use {{model-guid:slug}}.

sharedRows.topic: Data Explore Workflow and Critical Rules
sharedRows.whenToUse: Triggers: workflow, critical rules, execute dont ask, default value, definition mode, Discover, generated DAX, AutoApplied, no fabrication, no hand-written DAX. Examples: how should I answer a metric question, should I use GenerateQuery, when should I ask clarification. Intent: preserve the original data-explore execution contract.
sharedRows.routerHint: Overall data-explore workflow, no-fabrication rules, discovery/generate/execute contract.

sharedRows.whenToUse: Triggers: DiscoverQuestions, DiscoverMeasures, DiscoverColumns, SearchValues, SearchHierarchy, GenerateQuery, AnswerQuestion, AutoApplied, filter syntax, slice columns, rowLimit, sortMeasure, daxWrapper. Examples: how do I call Local.AskADIA.GenerateQuery, how do filters work. Intent: preserve the exact AskADIA UDF API guidance.

sharedRows.topic: Output, Formatting, Error Handling, Escape Hatch
sharedRows.whenToUse: Triggers: output format, formatting, numbers, dates, rows, empty results, errors, invalid filter, not sliceable, custom DAX, escape hatch. Examples: how should I present results, what if ExecuteQuery fails, can I write custom DAX. Intent: preserve answer-format and recovery guidance.
sharedRows.routerHint: Result formatting, number/date rules, row presentation, error recovery, custom-DAX last resort.
